subject: Renewal + expansion: invoicing routing, PO & tax paperwork for capacity upsell
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@stratuslabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion: invoicing routing, PO & tax paperwork for capacity upsell

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. To recap: Stratus is moving forward with the renewal + a 3x capacity uplift (same model family) under the existing contract number. Finance has asked us to collect the PO and confirm the billing contact and tax paperwork so invoices flow correctly after the addendum is activated. Can you confirm the following so we can finalize the order?

1) Formal PO number to reference on invoices (we'll need a PDF or scan).
2) Primary accounts-payable contact and email to route invoices to (you mentioned AP team earlier).
3) Any required invoice notes or internal reference fields (project code / cost center).
4) Whether you need our W-9/EIN included with the first invoice.

I've attached our standard W-9 for your records. We'll prepare an order addendum reflecting the capacity increase and proposed term adjustments (we noted you asked about extending net terms for the first period).

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_w9.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

Next steps: If you can send the PO PDF and confirm AP contact, I'll loop in Marissa (billing) to ingest the PO and Jordan to schedule the provisioning.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@stratuslabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap_team@stratuslabs.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 13:05:24 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: invoicing routing, PO & tax paperwork for capacity upsell

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the note and the W-9 — confirmed we have Stratus legal approval to proceed. Please reference PO number STRT-PO-8892 on all invoices. I've attached the signed PO for your records.

AP contact and invoice routing: ap_team@stratuslabs.com (please cc invoices@stratuslabs.com as well — internal routing rules require both addresses).

Invoice frequency: monthly, itemized by usage bucket (base capacity + overage).

Regarding terms: Procurement has requested Net45 for the initial renewal invoice cycle because of an internal calendar constraint. If you need an exception, please flag it and I can escalate.

Attachment: [Attachment: STRT-PO-8892.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Olivia Chen
Head of Procurement | Stratus Labs
olivia@stratuslabs.com | +1 (617) 222-7788

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@stratuslabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:23:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: invoicing routing, PO & tax paperwork for capacity upsell

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the PO. We can reference STRT-PO-8892 on invoices and will route to ap_team@stratuslabs.com (cc invoices@stratuslabs.com).

One note on net terms: Net45 is outside our standard renewal defaults; I'll need finance sign-off to make that change. Marissa — can you review and confirm whether we can accept Net45 as a one-time concession for this renewal (deal id DEAL-8732-STRATUS)? If so, we'll document it in the addendum.

Jordan — provisioning depends on the signed order addendum; I'll drop a draft in the thread this morning.

I'll attach the draft order addendum with the capacity uplift and a line item showing the new monthly commitment. If anything in the pricing or descriptions should be updated, let me know.

Attachments: [Attachment: order_addendum.pdf (PDF, 56KB)]

Thanks —
Marcus

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia@stratuslabs.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:45:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: invoicing routing, PO & tax paperwork for capacity upsell

Hi all —

I've reviewed PO STRT-PO-8892 and the order addendum. Finance (AR) approves a temporary Net45 for the first invoice cycle as a one-time concession tied to this upsell. Please note the concession is limited to the initial invoice dated after the renewal effective date; subsequent invoices will revert to Net30 per our standard T&C unless we agree to a permanent change and update the master contract.

Please confirm you will:
- Put STRT-PO-8892 on every invoice line
- Send invoices to ap_team@stratuslabs.com and cc invoices@stratuslabs.com
- Include the deal id DEAL-8732-STRATUS in the invoice notes

Once Olivia confirms routing and we have the signed addendum returned, we'll queue the billing setup and ensure the first invoice reflects Net45.

For tax paperwork: Marcus's W-9 is on file (thanks), no further forms required on our side. Olivia, if your finance team needs anything else (EIN cross-check or remit address), let us know and we'll provide immediately.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@stratuslabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:02:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: invoicing routing, PO & tax paperwork for capacity upsell

Thanks Marissa — that works for us.

I've attached the signed PO (signed copy for your archive). We'll expect monthly invoices, the first of which will be processed on Net45. Subsequent invoices can be Net30 per your note. Please ensure the invoice contains: STRT-PO-8892, DEAL-8732-STRATUS, and the itemized usage buckets.

AP contact confirmed: ap_team@stratuslabs.com (please use this for all invoices going forward).

Attachment: [Attachment: STRT-PO-8892_signed.pdf (PDF, 122KB)]

Olivia Chen
